study.question: Under fixed 100-event visibility and uniform-click/feedback-auxiliary compression, can auxiliary-private item/action residual embeddings recover auxiliary predictive information while retaining the click benefit of blocking auxiliary updates to base item tables?
study.hypothesis: The source-path factorial indicates that auxiliary access to trainable item/action representations is useful, while auxiliary updates to the shared base item tables can reduce click AUC in this single-seed recipe. A zero-initialized auxiliary-only ID residual, added to detached base target/history item/action embeddings before the existing local activation, gives auxiliary tasks an adaptation path without directly updating the click item representation. This is a representation-ownership hypothesis within compressed-history models, not proof of gradient conflict from observed AUC alone. It does not assert that residuals improve compression itself.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary DIN text inspected at lines 56-83 and 285-364, including adaptive history pooling and Dice batch/running statistics. Inherit local activation and Dice from the adapted baseline; neither arithmetic compression nor auxiliary-private residuals are an exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark source lines 17-160 uses task sequence projections and historical task-mask hubs with layerwise broadcasts. Our inherited feedback-union summaries are a simpler local adaptation; the new intervention is an auxiliary-only embedding residual before fixed arithmetic compression and a source-gradient factorial, with no hub or broadcast implementation. Not an original-INFNet reproduction.

Authorized read reports detailed original paper unavailable and points to unirank-benchmark-v2; that fallback was read. Only provenance is verified. Original-paper differences and novelty of shared/private residual embeddings remain unverified.

Pinned primary framework source inspected for categorical embedding shape, field aliases and direct lookup. Residuals use the same filtered IDs and preserve selected table aliases; they are separate zero-initialized parameters registered beneath embedding_layer. No new raw inputs or vocabulary changes.

inherited_components: Incumbent g2-r0004-context_only item/context embedding widths, tower construction and initialization order, action-aware shared local scorer, Dice, and four prediction heads.
Ten fixed temporal blocks of ten authorized history positions; per block one uniform slot and two auxiliary-feedback strata, with count-weighted unnormalized local-activation pooling.
Click reads the ten uniform slots; three auxiliary tasks read the twenty feedback-stratum slots. All thirty slots participate in each scorer call as in the accepted UF operator.
Frozen source-path rule: auxiliary scorer parameter gradients blocked, auxiliary context gradients open; no loss reweighting or training hook.
Frozen released masks, label semantics, data/splits, 100-event limit, host seed/recipe, optimizer families, four BCEs, full-validation scorer and resource limits.
study.proposed_difference: Add an optional full-width residual ID table for each distinct item/action table, preserving target/history tying and any selected field aliases. All residual weights start at zero after inherited reset_parameters, with CPU RNG restored around construction. Aux target = gate(base target) + residual target; aux historical value = gate(base value) + residual value. Arithmetic masked compression commutes with this addition. Residuals receive only auxiliary losses; they never enter the primary path. Cross the residual switch with the existing base-item gradient gate. Extra capacity is active and matched between private_residual and shared_residual; comparisons to no-residual cells intentionally differ in capacity and cannot alone establish an ownership mechanism. Residual-enabled inference must recompute auxiliary local activation because its representation differs; do not reuse primary weights after training.
predictions: Predeclared practical screen: private_residual click AUC at least 0.660146940486458 (incumbent minus 0.0005), auxiliary mean AUC at least 0.84 and every auxiliary AUC at least 0.82. Also report each task Logloss without hiding degradation. These tolerances are decision thresholds, not significance claims.

At matched added active capacity, private_residual should retain higher click AUC than shared_residual while remaining within 0.01 auxiliary mean AUC. Both differences must be reported even if the compound screen fails.

Within the blocked-base row, enabling the residual should recover auxiliary AUC relative to blocked_no_residual. Within the open-base row, the benefit may be smaller. Report this difference-in-differences descriptively to test whether private adaptation substitutes for shared-item updates.

Host preflight should find identical initial probabilities for all four cells with copied common weights, and no-residual endpoints should reproduce the earlier same-seed operators. For per-task backward checks: auxiliary gradients to residuals are nonzero on a nondegenerate valid-ID batch, click gradients to residuals are absent, blocked auxiliary base-item gradients and auxiliary scorer-parameter gradients are absent, and context gradients remain allowed.

No speedup is predicted from residuals. The two residual cells add the same parameter count and auxiliary scorer cost. Report quality versus measured allocated GPU seconds, wall seconds, examples processed, peak memory, and inference throughput/p50/p95 latency against both no-residual cells and full-history DIN.
falsifiers: Any current-label leakage, use of target action, unmasked history contribution, wrong output identity/shape, nonfinite predictions/loss/gradients, wrong optimizer assignment, alias violation or failed source-gradient invariant invalidates the implementation rather than refuting the scientific hypothesis.
If private_residual fails the joint practical screen, do not present it as a four-task recovery, even if click alone improves. In particular, repeating the incumbent auxiliary collapse is failure.

If the equal-active-capacity private/shared residual contrast has no click advantage or a material auxiliary deficit, this suite does not support representation ownership as the explanation. Residual gains over no-residual cells alone remain compatible with additional capacity.

A failure of auxiliary recovery with valid gradients is evidence against this residual implementation. It does not refute all private representations: inherited scorer normalization mismatch, scorer expressivity and one-pass fitting remain distinct explanations.
A speed or memory regression eliminates an efficiency claim for that cost view; lower theoretical slot count alone cannot establish end-to-end efficiency.
alternative_explanations: AUC differences in the previous factorial may arise from optimizer adaptation, loss gradient magnitudes, single-pass fitting or shared dense clipping rather than antagonistic gradient directions; no gradient-conflict statistic has been measured.

Residual tables add up to another item/action vocabulary times 16 parameters, and any improvement over the no-residual row may be extra capacity or task-adaptation freedom. Private versus shared residual is the equal-active-capacity contrast, but shared-gradient optimizer dynamics are part of that intervention.

Context remains shared, as do scorer parameters learned from click; global dense gradient clipping can also couple task updates. The experiment isolates direct item/action paths, not complete independence of trained click predictions.

Auxiliary residuals change the scorer input distribution. Persistent Dice buffers still update only on the primary call; train-time auxiliary batch statistics and inference running statistics may diverge. If recovery fails, this is a discriminating follow-up candidate, not an unannounced change to this suite.
The inherited thirty-slot Dice population includes empty slots; this suite preserves that operator and does not establish that count-weighted means equal eventwise nonlinear attention.
The residual bank is shared among all three auxiliary tasks, so competition among those tasks remains. No evidence here separates target-specific from historical-item or action residual effects.

Single seed and repeated validation-guided search can overstate gains. Same-seed replays test consistency only. Official offline feedback visibility and category/brand-based auxiliary label matching limit production interpretation.

trajectory_review.observations: Round0 target-match compression did not beat its occupancy-rotation control (0.657258 vs 0.657516); uniform10 was 0.657571. Round1 feedback/action yielded 0.656060 click and stronger auxiliaries than uniform histories; no click gain established. Round2 UF 0.655847 versus UU 0.657419 shows feedback-task improvement can coincide with click loss. Round3 both-blocked click 0.660041 but auxiliaries 0.641557/0.670936/0.630366 versus open 0.655824 click and 0.849028/0.869338/0.875838 auxiliaries. Round4 context-only click 0.660647, auxiliaries 0.664153/0.709596/0.668801; item-only click 0.658569, auxiliaries 0.843462/0.859277/0.856671. Neither and both endpoints exactly reproduced earlier corresponding AUCs at the same seed. These are multiple mechanism contrasts, not repeated-seed confirmation.
trajectory_review.interpretation: Observed AUC tradeoff supports investigating representation adaptation paths, but does not measure antagonistic gradients or prove any external method. Highest-click incumbent is inadequate as a joint four-task recovery. Target-match and feedback-for-every-task branches remain negative or null for click; no failed-execution status is present among authorized trajectories. Failed scientific hypotheses and runtime failures are distinct.
